hook.name: DTFFeeHook
hook.description: Swap-tax hook that skims a configurable buy/sell fee (always denominated in a fixed fee token) off every swap and forwards it directly to a treasury. Features a time-decaying launch tax (starting up to 90%, decaying linearly to the baseline fee over an immutable window) as an anti-sniper measure, with permanent exemptions for the protocol router and launcher. Fee rate and treasury are admin-adjustable via OpenZeppelin AccessManager.
